title: Bihu Tutorial | Basic Footwork and Waist Movements of Bihu Dance | Episode -1 with English Subtitles

method.teacher_system: The teacher first explains and demonstrates the correct posture and hand placement on the back. She then breaks down the basic footwork rhythm on counts before combining the hip sways with the foot movement. Finally, she provides practice tips and counts along with hand claps.
method.signature: She places her hands flat together on her lower back to demonstrate precise body posture before moving.

practices.what: The teacher demonstrates common incorrect hand placements on the sides of the waist versus correct lower back placement.
The teacher shows how the hands should rest joined together flat against the lower back without spread fingers.
The teacher isolates the posture by leaning slightly forward and moving the hips side to side on simple counts.
The teacher demonstrates how learners often incorrectly move their shoulders instead of isolating just the hips.
The teacher shows the basic foot stepping isolated before combining it with the waist movements.
The teacher combines the waist sway with the stepping footwork, counting slowly step by step.
The teacher repeats the combined footwork and hip movement from side views multiple times on counts.
The teacher advises practicing the movement in front of a mirror to self-correct form.
The teacher claps out the rhythmic count patterns to help time the step movements.

beliefs.belief: The teacher believes that practicing in front of a mirror is essential for learning.

feelings.response: The teacher explains that the awkward feeling comes from incorrect hand placement and shows the correct way.

moments.says: The teacher explains that placing hands on the sides is a common mistake and demonstrates the correct placement on the back.
The teacher instructs the learner to lean forward slightly to properly execute the waist movement.
The teacher encourages the learner to practice in front of a mirror and promises to return with more tutorials.

mentor.what_stays: The teacher leaves the learner feeling capable of mastering the dance through clear, step-by-step guidance.

struggles.theme: Living far from Assam or never getting a chance to learn
Shyness and low confidence preventing learning earlier
Difficulty learning hip and waist movements previously

clicked.theme: Detailed posture breakdown made movements possible

requests.theme: Upload the next parts and episodes of the tutorial series
Make more detailed tutorials on specific Bihu dance roles

meant.theme: Helped non-dancers and adults learn Bihu for weddings and festivals
Connected learners living far away to Assamese culture

method.limits: The video does not include practice with full Bihu music, focusing only on spoken counts and claps.
